paras: Phelsuma hoeschi is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to the Atsinanana Region of Madagascar.
The specific name, hoeschi, is in honor of German amateur herpetologist Udo Hoesch, who discovered this species.
The preferred natural habitat of P. hoeschi is unknown, as the species has only been collected from disturbed habitats near beaches and villages, at altitudes of 12–594 m (39–1,949 ft).
P. hoeschi is oviparous. Eggs are laid in knotholes of small trees.
